THE PLAYER'S PART: get in, cut three people loose, then hold the ground round them until help comes.

REWORKED 2026-10-30, his ruling: no escort ("yeah escort missions are meh, don't want them", confirming 10-24 "missions should not rely on NPCs doing stuff correctly"). The captives stay put; he holds the ground. Plan OT-70.

REWORKED 2026-11-10 on OT-9A: three kneeling captives, each a talk; Set Free or the closing line frees them. A captive may never be spoken to, so nothing the mission needs lives only in their lines: the broadcast and the journal carry it. Fixed order (talks do not group). ASKED of Eliza: the freed captives stay ignored by the attackers through the hold (a dial), since nothing fails if they die. Pay: hard.

FRANCES 2026-11-10 (reviews/2026-11-10-delve-MB82a.md): ship, findings 1-4 taken, 5-7 kept. Forced pick answered YES: the waves are the crew coming back for the three.
